verdict: Decision rule: does the path vary by input in a way that cannot be pre-enumerated? The three branching tickets (T008, T009, T010) do vary -- order missing or enterprise tier -- but both variants are finite and encodable as if/else in the workflow. The workflow matched or beat the agent on all four numbers: pass rate, p50 latency, total tokens, and cost per ticket. No ticket in this set forces an agent. The class that would require one is a ticket where the escalation path itself returns a dynamic follow-up order ID that cannot be known until the first tool responds -- none of the 10 tickets here has that property. Verdict: workflow wins.
